identification: Walk-behind petrol power trowel / power float ('helicopter'), about 90 cm (36 in) guard ring with 4 flat finishing blades, red-orange frame and gearbox housing, single tubular handle with throttle lever and a dangling kill/deadman bail, yellow Robin (Fuji Heavy/Subaru) EY-series horizontal-shaft engine, by size probably EY20 (5 hp). Old, paint worn, rust on blades and ring; engine pull start and fuel tank present. Trowel maker unknown (no plate legible). The red frame plus Robin engine matches Crommelins (Australian maker) livery, so possibly an old Crommelins; unconfirmed.
